instruction.text: Look at the bolded word(s) in the following sentence. What type of verbal is it? Select the correct answer.

hint.text:
An infinitive is a verbal made up of the word to and the simple form of a verb.
Gerunds are verbs that act as nouns. They end in -ing.
Participles can function as adjectives by describing or modifying nouns.
hint.sound:
An infinitive is a verbal made up of the word, to, and the simple form of a verb.
Gerunds are verbs that act as nouns. They end in -i n g.
Participles can function as adjectives by describing or modifying nouns.

atoms.a: Betty doesn’t know which suitcase to choose for her travels.
Seeing this amount of stars with the naked eye is only possible without light pollution.
The accomplished nurse, Florence Nightingale, was born in Italy.
Istanbul is a rare example of a city extending across two continents: Europe and Asia. In Turkey, it’s the place to be.
The scorching hot sensation you experience when eating spicy foods comes mostly from the capsaicin compound.
Since sound needs a medium like air or water to travel, it’s impossible to hear any sound in most vast areas of outer space.
Some people believe the ground-breaking idea of putting a hole in the donut came from a 16-year-old sailor in 1916.
Carrying all the groceries at once is difficult but saves time.
After the accident, he knew he needed to contact the police.
